verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform, so a public API with UI parity is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no documented public API. The only related line is a vague pricing bullet, "Advanced API integrations," which reads as connecting to third-party tools rather than a Firstbase API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and every workflow described (formation, compliance dashboard, state expansion, mail, bookkeeping) is presented as in-app or done-for-you.
